newsitem.title: FINLAND: CS FIRST BOSTON CUTS RAUMA EPS FORECASTS.
newsitem.headline: CS FIRST BOSTON CUTS RAUMA EPS FORECASTS.

text.p: CS First Boston said in a brokers note on Friday it had cut its 1996 and 1997 EPS forecasts for Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy after it posted weaker-than-expected eight-month earnings on Thursday.
"We downgrade our 1996 EPS from 11.8 markka to 10.5 (markka), and our 1997 EPS from 12.6 (markka) to 11.5 (markka)," CS First Boston said.

It described Rauma's January-August's pre-tax profit at 420 million markka as "well below expectations". Rauma's Timberjack forestry machinery division was hit by "a very weak market," CS First Boston said.
